answer: I ran one Bell-state job on the real IQM QPU sirius with 100 shots. The circuit put H on qubit 0, then a CNOT from qubit 0 to qubit 1, then measured both qubits. The job ID is 01a15f39-f662-7371-bc2f-a7002055e7ca and it finished with status DONE. The counts were 00: 57, 11: 35, 10: 5, 01: 3. Both bits agreed in 92 of 100 shots, which is a fraction of 0.92. My first attempt failed during client setup because I passed the token as an argument and also set it as an environment variable. That attempt submitted no job. The script is at /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_f3caa17a-2c4-1/run_bell.py.
